Imports another template. The `.html` extension is optional; Teddy appends it for you. Pass arguments with child `` elements. ```html Plain text argument ``` With an `as` attribute the template is rendered as a web component instead, inside the custom element you name. Any child that is not an `` then becomes that element's light DOM, which is what a `` in the component projects. ```html Kettle

Boils water in under a minute.

 ```

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Path to the template to import, relative to the template root. The `.html` extension is optional.

description.value:
Renders the template as a web component inside the custom element named here, rather than in place of the include.

The name has to be one a custom element can have: lower case, and holding at least one hyphen. Teddy refuses anything else.

Every other attribute written on the include is put on the element it renders as, which is how a custom element is configured.

Where the component's markup goes. Read only alongside `as`.

The fallback copy is the same template rendered again without its `<style>`, `<script>` and `<slot>` elements, none of which can do their job in the light DOM.

values.name: both
values.description: The default. A declarative shadow root and a fallback copy of it. Only one of the two is ever shown, so the component renders whatever the browser turns out to support, at the cost of writing the markup twice.

values.name: shadow
values.description: The declarative shadow root alone. Smaller, but a browser without declarative shadow DOM support renders nothing at all, as does anything that reads HTML without being a browser.

values.name: light
values.description: The fallback alone, written into the element's light DOM, with no shadow root. The element is still yours to upgrade, but nothing is encapsulated until you do it yourself.

description.value:
Sends the component the part of the model it renders from, as JSON in a script beside its shadow root, so the class upgrading it can render the same template again from new data without asking a server for anything. Read only alongside `as`.

Names whole model keys, comma separated, rather than paths into them. A bare `hydrate` is refused, as is a name holding a dot.

```html
<include src="productCard" as="product-card" hydrate="product"></include>
```

Declares an argument passed to an included template. The argument name is the attribute name, and the element's contents are its value.

```html
<arg firstArgument>Plain text argument</arg>
```

The child template reads it as `{firstArgument}`. Use the `|s` flag to render HTML in an argument: `{htmlArgument|s}`.

Renders its contents when a condition passes.

`<if something>` checks whether `something` is present in the model. `<if something="hello">` checks its value.

Combine conditions with the `and`, `or`, and `xor` attributes, or negate one with the `not:` prefix. Operators are evaluated left to right. A variable cannot be queried twice in one statement, and an operator cannot be used twice in one statement, because HTML forbids repeating an attribute on an element.

attributes.name: and
attributes.description: Renders if the preceding condition and this one are both true.

attributes.name: or
attributes.description: Renders if either the preceding condition or this one is true.

attributes.name: xor
attributes.description: Renders if exactly one of the preceding condition and this one is true.

description.value:
Renders its contents when a condition fails: the inverse of `<if>`.

`<unless something>` renders when `something` is absent from the model.

Caches a block of template code that resolves to the same markup often, so Teddy does not re-render it on every pass. ```html

High today in {city} is {value}.

 ```

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the cache, so it can be cleared from JavaScript with `teddy.clearCache(name)`.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: The model property used to index new caches.

attributes.name: maxAge
attributes.description: How old a cache may get, in milliseconds, before it is invalidated and re-rendered. Default: `0`, meaning no limit.

attributes.name: maxCaches
attributes.description: The maximum number of caches for this element. When the maximum is reached the least recently created or accessed cache is dropped. Default: `1000`.
